correctness.rationale: Lemma 2.9 of Elias–Ko supplies the independently checked idempotent classification. The support-union property and idempotency of a commuting product force the union parabolic-longest element. For any component not fully in either support, forbidden edges p in C\J, q in C\K prevent an endpoint label crossing both in two stages. If each component belongs wholly to one, absorbing longest factors prove commutation. Four-state allowed-run counts produce the bivariate rational series. Characteristic-root differentiation produces exact mean/variance and Chebyshev concentration. Saved checker independently exhausts 46,233 permutations and 21,845 candidate pairs; finite experiments are supportive only.

value.rationale: Commutation among idempotents is a canonical algebraic structural property of an important finite monoid. The result refines the previously studied idempotent noncommuting graph by natural Coxeter union-support size; it quantifies the typical support and variance, yielding a complete all-rank distribution not included in OEIS A007070. This is not claimed as novelty of an existing integer sequence.
